chunks: He will command you to do evil, indecency, and to speak of God what you do not know.
ai.seo_question: What does the devil command humans to do according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Baqarah is often cited as the definitive description of Iblis's tripartite strategy to mislead humanity, emphasizing not just external actions but internal cognitive distortion. It underscores the devil's role in promoting 'fahsha' (indecency) and 'sue'' (evil) as a means to obscure divine truth, a concept central to understanding the spiritual battle between guidance and misguidance. The phrase 'what they do not know' highlights the propagation of ignorance regarding God's attributes and commands, a key theme in Shia theological discourse on fitrah (innate disposition).
